additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
540 mana, 2.25 mana regeneration and 4.5% flat base magic resistance.
31.5 main attack damage to universal heroes.
description: The cursed brooch of a fallen guardian who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.
tips: Because attacks of Revenant's Brooch deal magical damage, this item is very effective against heroes with high armor and/or high agility (every 6 agility points gives 1 armor point) like Terrorblade, Phantom Assassin, Drow Ranger, Axe, Dawnbreaker, Pantheon, Morphling, Spectre, Slark, Naga Siren, Holy Knight, Wraith King.

Revenant's Brooch's active ability allows it's owner to freely attack ethereal units, making this item very useful against heroes who rely on ethereal abilities or Ghost Scepter for survival like Muerta, Pugna, Necrophos, Skywrath Mage, Tinker, Grimstroke, Ogre Magi, Io.

Revenant's Brooch's spell lifesteal is useful for heroes who have abilities that can deal magical damage with their abilities: Lina, Luna, Jakiro, Outworld Destroyer, Ancient Apparition, Jakiro, Broodmother, Death Prophet, Dawnbreaker, Gyrocopter, Razor, Pugna, Pantheon, Ember Spirit, Earth Spirit, Storm Spirit, Void Spirit, Vengeful Spirit, Shadow Shaman, Enigma, Dark Willow, Venomancer.

Heroes who struggle against abilities and items that can turn the user ethereal will benefit greatly from Revenant's Brooch's ability that can allow directly attacking of etheral units: Naga Siren, Broodmother, Lycan, Visage, Templar Assassin, Lifestealer, Medusa, Wraith King, Alchemist, Dazzle, Spectre, Weaver.
Revenant's Brooch costs 50 mana for attacking while active, so it's not recommended to go for it when enemies have lots of way to burn away your mana.

Revenant's Brooch disables the ability to have your attacks deal critical damage, so this item is not recommended for heroes that have abilities that can deal critical damage unless you are willing to trade ability to deal critical damage for ability to attack ethereal units: Phantom Assassin, Juggernaut, Tusk, Monkey King, Wraith King, Lycan, Holy Knight, Brewmaster, Pantheon, Dawnbreaker, Void Spirit.

notes: Counts as a Critical Strike for purposes of stacking with other sources of Critical Strike.
Phantom Critical does not work against buildings.
abilities.description: Grants each attack a 30% chance to deal an additional 80% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.

name: Revenant's Brooch
